I usually tolerate clipping, but the CD/Bandcamp version is too excessive even for me. It's borderline unlistenable. Thankfully Spotify version comes to the rescue. It's not on the same level, as say, Abbey Road, but now i can actually appreciate the drumming and nice guitar work without my ears being assaulted. It's also in slightly higher dynamic range which is nice.


The red lines indicate clipping (or rectangles in this case since it's so excessive).
